# Dinner From Fridge

> Cook dinner tonight from what is already in your fridge. Scan ingredients, browse a world recipe catalog, match leftovers to meals, track nutrition, and plan the week — with no pork products in the catalog.

## Site
- Homepage: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/
- About: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/about
- Recipe search: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/recipes?q={query}
- Fridge scan: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/capture
- Nutrition calculator: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/nutrition
- Goals / nutrition plan: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/goals
- Shopping list: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/shopping

## Cook-time landings
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cook/15-min — dinners in about 15 minutes
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cook/20-min
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cook/30-min
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cook/45-min

## Cuisine landings
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cuisine/desi — Desi / South Asian
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cuisine/arabic — Arabic / Middle Eastern
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cuisine/chinese
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cuisine/western
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/cuisine/mexican

## Growth tools
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/sample-fridge — try a sample fridge: a pre-made scan result, no sign-up
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/leftover-rescue — leftover rescue / empty-fridge mode: dinners with only 2–4 main ingredients (salt, oil, spices assumed). Optional ?i=eggs,rice,bell+pepper
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/challenge — fridge challenge: pick 2–5 ingredients and share a link, e.g. https://dinnerfromfridge.com/challenge?i=eggs,spinach,rice
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/streak — home-cooked streak and estimated money saved (stored on the device)

## Seasonal & cultural collections (halal-friendly, no pork)
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/ramadan — Ramadan: iftar from your fridge and quick suhoor ideas (English, with Arabic and Urdu summaries)
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/eid — Eid feast dishes and Eid leftover makeovers
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/desi — Desi (Pakistani / Indian / Bangladeshi) dinners: karahi, daal, biryani
- https://dinnerfromfridge.com/arabic — Arabic dinners: kabsa, mandi, shawarma, shakshuka, hummus

## Recipes
Individual recipes are at https://dinnerfromfridge.com/recipe/{id}
Example: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/recipe/seed-chicken-caesar-wrap-dinner

Full catalog index: https://dinnerfromfridge.com/sitemap.xml

## Product facts
- Turns fridge / pantry ingredients into dinner ideas (scan or type).
- Catalog of world recipes with cook steps, scaled ingredients, and optional nutrition.
- Week plan, favorites, and shopping list tools.
- Dietary preference chips (e.g. vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, halal, keto, high-protein).
- Policy: the recipe catalog does not include pork products.
- Share: recipe and result pages can be shared as 9:16 story images, WhatsApp links or plain links.
- Languages: English, Arabic, Spanish, French, Turkish, Urdu (right-to-left for Arabic and Urdu).

## Contact / canonical
- Canonical site: https://dinnerfromfridge.com
